EXACT logical 16x16 pixel canvas, coarse square pixels, no finer detail; if output is enlarged, enlarge this grid only. One centered food with 1-2 logical pixels transparent margin; fills the slot like vanilla ham. Fully transparent alpha background. Limited 6-9 flat colors, gentle upper-left light, subtle colored outline, recognizable stepped silhouette; no black outline, no gradients, no blur, no photorealism, no ground shadow, no glow, no lettering, no plate, no props, no extra detached slices. Slight three-quarter view where appropriate. Subject: One oblong squared slab of boneless speck, about 12 pixels wide by 8 high, three-quarter view with broad burgundy lean face, thick cream fat cap and outer rind. No bone or round sausage. Dark chestnut smoky crust #694335, deep wine-red lean #963e48, thick ivory fat cap, slight amber edge. Dark rectangular smoked ham distinct from tan pear-shaped prosciutto.
